'''Tomoko Kobashi''' (Japanese: '''小橋知子''' ''Kobashi Tomoko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Kobashi was born on December 24, 1980, in {{wp|Okayama}}, {{wp|Okayama Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She was affiliated with Ken Production. Kobashi became involved with the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, replacing [[Tomo Adachi]] as [[Professor Sycamore]]'s assistant, [[Sophie]], starting in [[XY039]].
